description: This file is a script for analyzing plugin extension import boundaries in a TypeScript project. It imports various utility modules, defines functions to scan source files for import violations and registry smells, and performs inventory checks against baseline data. It also includes functions for formatting and reporting violations.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries for sorting purposes based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for a resolved extension path, indicating whether it is an extension implementation, entry point, or owned file.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a source file for import boundary violations related to plugin extensions.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects registry smells in the web search providers source file.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be skipped based on its path.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory data on plugin extension import boundary violations, with caching.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the expected inventory JSON file, with caching.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Diffs the expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the inventory check and comparison, outputting results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the import boundary check script.
